title: Week 1: Settling in Dumaguete & Finding Faith by the Coast

verse.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

entries.text: Preparation Day! Started the morning emailing family and loved ones, washing barongs and shirts, and buying fresh mangoes at the public market. In the afternoon, we played basketball with the district elders under the coconut palms. Grateful for this fresh start in Dumaguete.

entries.text: Morning companionship study was centered on Alma 26:12 — "Yea, I know that I am nothing; as to my strength I am weak; therefore I will not boast of myself, but I will boast of my God." Spent the afternoon finding new investigators in Sibulan. The people here truly live up to Dumaguete being the "City of Gentle People."

entries.text: Taught the Bautista family Lesson 1 on the Restoration of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. We read 3 Nephi 11 together and felt such a peaceful spirit fill their home. Afterwards, they shared chilled buko juice with us. We invited them to be baptized on October 10th and they accepted!
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="450" viewBox="0 0 600 450"><rect width="600" height="450" fill="%234299e1"/><circle cx="300" cy="180" r="100" fill="%232b6cb0"/><path d="M220 200 Q300 320 380 200 Z" fill="%23e2e8f0"/><text x="50%25" y="88%25" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="%23ffffff" font-weight="bold">Wednesday: Teaching the Bautista Family</text></svg>

entries.text: Attended our weekly District Council meeting in Dumaguete. Practiced Cebuano language roleplays and discussed how to help returning members feel welcome. It is humbling to see the dedication of all the elders and sisters serving across Negros Oriental.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="450" viewBox="0 0 600 450"><rect width="600" height="450" fill="%23ecc94b"/><circle cx="260" cy="210" r="50" fill="%23d69e2e"/><circle cx="340" cy="210" r="50" fill="%23b7791f"/><text x="50%25" y="88%25" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="%232d3748" font-weight="bold">Thursday: Dumaguete District Council</text></svg>

entries.text: Community service day! We helped Nanay Elena repair her bamboo gate and weeded her garden after the recent afternoon tropical downpour. Sweat soaked through our shirts, but her smile of gratitude made every single minute worth it. Service brings pure joy.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="450" viewBox="0 0 600 450"><rect width="600" height="450" fill="%234fd1c5"/><rect x="120" y="80" width="360" height="240" rx="10" fill="%23234e52"/><text x="50%25" y="88%25" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="%23ffffff" font-weight="bold">Friday: Service in Valencia</text></svg>

entries.text: Finding by the coastal boulevard! Walking along Rizal Boulevard just as the sun was setting over the sea, we struck up a conversation with two university students from Silliman University. They asked thoughtful questions about faith and the Book of Mormon. Handed them a copy with our personal testimonies inscribed inside.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="450" viewBox="0 0 600 450"><rect width="600" height="450" fill="%23ed64a6"/><circle cx="300" cy="180" r="80" fill="%23b83280"/><path d="M0 320 L600 320 L600 450 L0 450 Z" fill="%233182ce"/><text x="50%25" y="88%25" dominant-baseline="middle" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="%23ffffff" font-weight="bold">Saturday: Sunset at Rizal Boulevard</text></svg>

entries.text: Sunday Sabbath in the Dumaguete 1st Ward. Brother Bautista and his daughter came to church for the first time! The talks during Sacrament meeting were so spiritual and centered on Jesus Christ as the Prince of Peace. Finished the evening reviewing our week and preparing this email to send to the dummy Gmail inbox for tomorrow morning's P-Day!
